message:
Hello,
I am Koustubh and I along with my fiance are planning to buy a villa of 50*30 plot size in a villa project coming up near Soukya Road. This project suits us from the point of view of our budget, the location and the amenities. However there is one major challenge - we absolutely dislike the current design of their villas. We have expressed our concern to the developer and have come to the alignment that we can do whatever change we want during the construction provided we do not change the frontal elevation. In this context, we want to partner with an architect who is able to collaborate with us in designing our house to optimize for our requirements while also satisfying the frontal elevation constraint. I came across your past project on buildofy and felt that the my preferences resonate with your design language. I'd love to have a discussion with you to explore if you'd be up for this challenge!
Thanks

~30*40 sq ft.

Location - Banashankari 3rd stage, Bangalore 

Approx start date - Dec 1st

Type - Minimal, brutalist, need to play around with light and shadows, make the most of sunlight in the day, and yellow warm soft tones by evenings. Soft corners, large walls,doors, double heighted ceiling, 

Loved your projects, you get it!

Hello,

This is Siddharth Jain from Ashiana Housing Ltd. We are a Delhi based company and the country's number 1 developer in senior living. We are expanding operations to Bengaluru and looking for consultants here.

We had a look at the work you do and really liked it.

Pls get in touch

Thanks,
Siddharth
